name: Speed of Light in Vacuum
description: Speed of all electromagnetic waves in vacuum

name: Planck Constant
description: Quantum of electromagnetic action relating photon energy to frequency

name: Newtonian Constant of Gravitation
description: Proportionality constant in Newton's law of universal gravitation

name: Elementary Charge
description: Electric charge carried by a single proton or magnitude of electron charge

name: Boltzmann Constant
description: Relates average kinetic energy of gas particles with thermodynamic temperature

name: Avogadro Constant
description: Number of constituent particles in one mole of a substance

name: Vacuum Electric Permittivity
description: Capability of vacuum to permit electric field lines

name: Molar Gas Constant
description: Universal gas constant in ideal gas law PV = nRT

name: Standard Acceleration of Gravity
description: Standard gravitational acceleration at sea level on Earth

name: Stefan-Boltzmann Constant
description: Constant in Stefan-Boltzmann blackbody radiation law
